previousGap: The common infected only cycled three grounded authored hand attacks. The decoded jump windup, finite targeting window, zero-damage approach probe, conditional wrist strike and landing branch had no runtime counterpart.
implemented: Separate synchronized leap action with seven-tick windup and five-tick fast-aim cutoff. Airborne tracking now follows the verified P1 50-degree/second bounded-direction rule; see continuation record.
One actual vanilla-physics launch. After five release ticks, two approach probes may arm the punch branch; the probes never call hurt.
Only the rendered right wrist's swept path can damage the committed valid target during punch ticks 4..11, with one lawful doHurtTarget attempt per leap.

Living target validity, allies, disguise, creative/spectator, consume protection, incoming-hit interruption and existing damage-event rules remain in the path. Seated vehicle occupants do not become leap targets through their hull.
Landing has a separate synchronized recovery clock. Wall collision, water, target invalidation, restraint, changed windup cover and timeout abort the action.
A failed geometry check also starts an 80-tick retry cooldown; existing ordinary movement may continue instead of retrying the leap every tick.
Each coarse swept body envelope and its one-block collision-query border is checked with VehicleKinematics.loaded/getChunkNow before noCollision. The check does not request new chunks.
The visible trail follows the rendered right wrist and the conditional punch window; the old generic left-hand/absolute-clock fallback is not used for this action.
minecraftAdaptations: 20 Hz rounded timing: windup 7 ticks, aiming first 5 ticks at up to 36 degrees per tick after commitment, approach probes 5 ticks after launch, punch damage ticks 4..11.
Entry uses horizontal range 3..5 blocks and vertical separation at most 0.8 blocks, with visibility and grounded/adult/non-water availability.
Launch speed is clamp(distance/8,0.25,0.65), vertical velocity 0.45. This is a Minecraft gravity adapter, not decoded JumpTo parameters.

Clearance is a ten-step coarse estimate using move then horizontal drag 0.91 and vertical (vy-0.08)*0.98; it conservatively rejects obstructed starts. Vanilla living collision/physics controls actual motion, so this is not a deterministic root-motion reproduction.
Two zero-damage probe regions use forward distances 1.5 and 0.75, center height 0.75 and 0.4 half-extent. Wrist sweep uses the actual block-person arm/forearm and a 0.25 target expansion.

Original source damage 50 and source impulse values are retained as evidence only. Damage uses the mob's existing ATTACK_DAMAGE and combat balance; accepted hits use existing knockback with strength 0.4.
Landing recovery 10 ticks, timeout 48 ticks and retry cooldown 80 ticks are Minecraft pacing values; original landing duration is not decoded.
The visible joint curves are authored block-person animation aligned to the decoded states. No original P1 animation clip/mesh retargeting or original sounds are claimed.
